title: Survival · Stone and soil
description: Review material identity, pixel structure, and repeated surfaces alongside neighboring terrain.

entries.focus: Natural fracture structure; no baked tile border.
Readable stones and mortar without a repeated square outline.
Retain dark stone detail in shade; distinguish from obsidian.
Recognizable glassy volcanic material at ordinary game scale.
Deliberate soil clusters rather than uniform noise.
Top/side continuity and snowy state behavior.
